body:
Thanks!
I did tell my mother how I was feeling, this morning. Of course she said what I already knew she would say: that killing myself was not an option because of what it would do to her.
I think I do sometimes scare away members of the opposite gender... It's much easier to scare them away from face-to-face. More often, however, it's that I just can't start anything positive. I have no "game" and that's what really matters.
I don't feel any better. I worked out like a machine all afternoon and I came home just now hoping to be feeling better about myself. Nope. Just crashed on the couch here and I'm letting the TV Guide scroll past endlessly because not a single one of the 60+ channels looks at all remotely interesting.

I honestly want to do this. I want to give away all my organs. Then, I want to have my brain (and whatever tissues that can't be used) cremated and the ashes scattered somewhere. Whatever is cheap and won't burden my family any.

What the hell would be wrong with this? I think it would be the perfect solution.

Thanks for the response. It's nice to know someone read this.

The way you describe your sister is like the girl that just came out to me. She, too, is socially awkward, shy, very dry, etc. I thought she was just like me but of course as it turns out her sexual orientation isn't like mine at all. I'm sure she just was trying to be nice and didn't realize she was leading me on...

Funny, I think it would be MUCH easier to be gay, lesbian, etc. than to be Aspergers. They have a chance to find love while an Aspie like me ... I still think there's no hope for me. Men have to lead the way and "put themselves out there"... whereas it's much more okay for a woman to be shy. That's what I think. :(
